categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies wallet feebumper logic (`CreateRateBumpTransaction`) to validate change output indices and refactor return types.
categories.rationale: Prevents silently dropping non-destination outputs such as `OP_RETURN` when bumping transaction fees. Previously, specifying an `original_change_index` pointing to an output lacking a destination caused the feebumper to silently drop it and generate a new change output instead of raising an error.
